question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**challenging**" describes something that is difficult and tests** one's abilities.**
 
• In this context, **"challenging times"** refers to periods of difficulty or hardship.
 
• The other options: "**initial**", "**wasteful**", and "**joyful**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Family plays a vital role in our lives, serving as a source of love, support, and stability. It is within the family unit that we develop lasting bonds, learn essential values, and find comfort during challenging__ times.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Initial (प्रारंभिक)**: means occurring at the beginning.
 
• **Wasteful (अपव्ययी)**: means using or expending something carelessly.
 
• **Joyful (प्रसन्न)**: means feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness.
